commits.subject: Use the state database first for TUI analytics thread lists (#62138)
commits.reason: Use the database for root analytics listings to avoid filesystem scans and metadata repair during normal pagination. A typed internal server error restarts once in the repairing mode and discards all database results and cursors. Descendant listing, cutoff filtering, backend ownership, and analytics opt-in behavior stay in their existing paths.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit binary patch, SHA256 615e78f4c0ef7184056813b856993c6ab7d140a4cacdf3cd4bbcc123bb596cf4.

The source tests cover an indexed second-page error, exclusion of discarded rows, separate usage-estimate timing, and database-only routing for root requests while archived descendants use the existing path.
commits.revisit: Verify root analytics on the composed backend with a complete database, a second-page internal error, failure in repairing mode, and archived descendants. Check that fallback does not switch the selected app-server handle.
